senses.gloss: f. (נָשַׁךְ) biting, bite. Mekh. Mishp., N’ziḳin, s. 12; Y. B. Kam. I, beg. 2ᵃ. Bab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 2b:9">B. Kam. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ תולדה דשן היא</he> is not biting a species of damage by the tooth? <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:10">Ab. II, 10</cite> <he>נְשִׁיכָתָן נְשִׁיכַת וכ׳</he> their (the scholars’) bite is the bite of a fox; a. e.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 6:2:5">Y. Ter. VI, end, 44ᵇ</cite> <he>נשיכת פיאה</he>, read <he>נשירת</he>, v. <cite ref="N01322"><he>נְשִׁירָה</he></cite>.]
